profile.headline: Engineering Manager / Delivery Manager (Team Lead & Scrum Master) | SAFe 6.0 Certified | Driving Operational Efficiency, AI-Enhanced Delivery & Cross-Functional Alignment
profile.jobTitle: Engineering Manager / Delivery Manager (Team Lead & Scrum Master)
profile.summary:
I’m an Engineering Manager and Scrum Master with experience guiding multi‑team delivery, strengthening organizational maturity, and driving operational excellence. With a foundation in software engineering and a proven ability to lead people, processes, and execution, I focus on building scalable delivery frameworks and enabling teams to deliver predictable, high‑quality outcomes.

I specialize in aligning priorities, managing cross‑team dependencies, improving throughput, and partnering with Product, QA, Infrastructure, Architecture, and Support to remove blockers and accelerate delivery. My leadership approach emphasizes clarity, accountability, psychological safety, and continuous improvement.

I’m passionate about developing people, improving processes, and creating environments where teams can thrive. I excel in roles where engineering, operations, and execution intersect — helping organizations scale, mature, and deliver consistently.

positions.title: Engineering Manager / Delivery Manager (Team Lead & Scrum Master)
positions.description:
Leading multi-team delivery execution, operational improvement, and organizational maturity for a large initiative automating how financial institutions collect, classify, and process customer documents using AI-driven workflows.

Leadership and Delivery Execution
●  Lead delivery across multiple engineering teams, aligning priorities, staffing, release planning, customer commitments, and dependencies.
●  Cascade organizational goals and OKRs to ensure alignment with strategic objectives.
●  Agile ceremonies and execution rhythms to reinforce predictable delivery and continuous improvement.
●  Provide day-to-day leadership across teams to ensure clarity, alignment, and disciplined execution.

Operational Excellence
●  Build scalable delivery models through milestones, program governance, daily execution controls, and WIP limits.
●  Improve throughput, cycle time, and predictability across engineering teams.
●  Strengthen planning, risk management, release readiness, and feature delivery ownership.
●  Introduce practices that improve engineering discipline, testing readiness, and release quality.
●  Coach teams on sustainable delivery practices to improve readiness and execution consistency.

Cross-Functional Coordination
●  Partner with Product, QA, Infrastructure, Architecture, and Support to remove blockers and accelerate delivery.
●  Lead resolution of customer-facing defects and escalations while improving support processes.
●  Translate workflow and AI-driven capabilities into actionable requirements for engineering teams.

Strategic Impact
●  Direct release-critical activities to maintain customer commitments and deployment timelines.
●  Deliver measurable improvements in delivery performance and execution consistency.
●  Serve as liaison to senior leadership with data-driven progress updates and risk assessments.

positions.title: Manager, Principal Consultant
positions.description:
I successfully led initiatives that enhanced operational efficiency and promoted team collaboration at Workstate.  

●     Led two internal initiatives aimed at enhancing operational efficiency and improving team collaboration across the organization.
●     Collaborated directly with senior management to drive project success and ensure alignment with strategic business objectives.
●     Managed a team of direct reports, fostering a collaborative and high-performing work environment.
●     Supported the onboarding process for new team members, ensuring smooth integration and alignment with team goals.
●     Advocated for the needs and professional development of direct reports, ensuring their voices were heard and supported.
●     Addressed disciplinary matters as needed, maintaining a fair and consistent approach.
●     Conducted performance reviews and offered career development guidance, providing constructive feedback to improve employee performance.
●     Recognized individual achievements while fostering professional growth and development within the team.
●     Collaborated regularly with Tech Leads to review and discuss the performance of direct reports.
●     Organized and facilitated monthly team meetings to ensure alignment and address key priorities.
●     Conducted bi-annual retrospectives with each direct report, fostering continuous improvement and professional growth.
●     Managed and approved PTO requests, ensuring adequate coverage while supporting work-life balance.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer, Principal Consultant
positions.description:
I successfully led various initiatives that improved system efficiency and compliance.  

●     Served as Tech Lead for onboarding a new payment processor, allowing the client to expand its capabilities to board new merchants through an existing platform. Collaborated with overseas developers (unity team) to map data to new endpoints, and ensured all team submissions were deployed successfully and without issue during releases.
●     Worked on ensuring NACHA compliance for the client across a broad range of applications and databases, researching all systems to identify locations where plain-text account numbers were in use and encrypting them. Migrated potentially sensitive documents to Azure Blob Storage.
●     Helped design and create a monitoring application to proactively find and diffuse incidents; researched potential problem areas and proposed monitors via application, database, and report analysis, and performed knowledge transfers to all engineers in the company.
●     Migrated service requests from Zendesk to Salesforce, developing Salesforce interface implementations and console applications for data migrations, while conducting robust testing under aggressive deadlines.  
●     As part of a re-platforming effort, managed the creation of a NoSQL data model based on an existing relational data model and legacy endpoints.
●     Created Terraform scripts to deploy infrastructure to AWS, deployed locally using AWS CLI and via GitLab, and performed a knowledge transfer to the Technical Manager and all members of the team. 
●     Added an enhancement to an existing report required by new business needs; analyzed the various applications and databases used to compose the report and collaborated directly with stakeholders to understand and confirm changes.
●     Resolved multiple long-standing bugs in client code, leading to a dramatic decrease in the number of support tickets.

positions.title: Project Manager, Principal Consultant
positions.description:
I played a pivotal role in driving project success at Workstate by managing both project execution and technical leadership.  

●     Served as Project Manager while also serving as Tech Lead due to resource limitations.
●     Collaborated with Product Owners to define, prioritize, and refine epics and user stories, ensuring alignment with business goals and technical requirements.
●     Utilized project management tools such as Jira, Trello, and Confluence to monitor progress, track issues, and communicate updates to Product Owners.
●     Led sprint ceremonies including backlog grooming, daily stand-ups, and retrospectives, fostering team collaboration and continuous improvement.
●     Managed team workflows, ensuring smooth execution of sprints and timely delivery of features by facilitating clear communication and removing roadblocks.
●     Facilitated cross-functional collaboration between development, product, and design teams, ensuring alignment on priorities and expectations.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
I played a pivotal role in modernizing client applications at Theoris Services, leveraging ETL tools to enhance functionality.  

• Engaged with clients to understand their needs and deliver tailored solutions.  
• Fostered collaboration among cross-functional teams to maintain project timelines and quality standards.  
• Developed strong problem-solving skills to tackle technical challenges effectively.
positions.insights: Skills: Extract, Transform, Load (ETL) · ETL Tools · Technical Consultation · Consulting

positions.title: Full Stack Developer and Quality Engineer
positions.description:
I actively contributed to the development and enhancement of web applications, focusing on improving internal productivity and accuracy.  

●     Developed a process for finding application issues using Application Insights, currently in active use by a development team. 
●     Developed a process involving a synchronization tool to ensure BDD scenarios are coordinated with Azure DevOps, now in use by multiple business units within the company. 
●     Full-stack feature development of web applications for both Healthcare and Tax divisions, used internally by Crowe staff to increase productivity and accuracy.
●     Participated in resolution of support issues for web applications across Healthcare and Tax divisions. 
●     Upgraded applications and converted them from ASP.NET Web Forms to MVC using Angular.
●     Collaborated directly with clients to ensure application features met their needs via requirements gathering.
●     Participated and engaged in Agile/Scrum team ceremonies.
●     Performed efficient troubleshooting and identification of root causes via Application Insights and code analysis.
●     Participated in product team reviews of feature coverage in relation to the automation pyramid and ensured automation goals aligned with the team's quality strategy.
●     Ensured the product team designed, developed, and executed automation scripts as well as manual test cases when applicable. 
●     Worked closely with the development team to integrate test cases into test suites. 
●     Aided tech leads in upholding test automation best practices via code reviews. 
●     Contributed to automation best practices and knowledge sharing within the direct product team as well as other teams within the company.
●     Worked with the product team to identify and develop additional skills needed to be successful on the team.
positions.insights: Skills: Angular · NUnit · Manual Testing · Process Improvement · xUnit · Selenium · Azure DevOps Services · application insights · Full-Stack Development · Test Automation

positions.title: Student
positions.description:
I developed practical skills and knowledge through my studies at IUPUI, culminating in a Bachelor of Science in Computer Science.  

• Collaborated on real-world client projects, creating tailored applications to meet specific needs.  
• Strengthened problem-solving abilities and communication skills throughout my academic journey.  
• Achieved a final GPA of 3.37, demonstrating my commitment to academic excellence.
positions.insights: Skills: Public Speaking · Mathematics · Language Arts · Computer Science · Theory of Computation

positions.title: Web Developer
positions.description:
I played a pivotal role in enhancing a major web application for Washington National, ensuring it met user needs through close collaboration.  

• Worked in an agile environment to implement design improvements and features.  
• Developed strong skills in JavaScript, HTML, CSS, and Data Tables, focusing on user experience.  
• Ensured cross-browser compatibility across IE9, Firefox, and Chrome for a consistent experience.

positions.title: Purchasing Agent/Senior Site Specialist
positions.description:
I successfully oversaw procurement operations, ensuring efficiency and compliance with company standards.  

• Utilized a Lilly-issued procurement card for accurate bookkeeping and procurement management.  
• Conducted market research and supplier interviews to enhance sourcing strategies and product information.  
• Handled customer and supplier inquiries, ensuring clear communication and timely resolutions.
positions.insights: Skills: Customer Service · Inventory Management · Cross-functional Coordination · Procurement · Cost-Benefit Analysis · Time Management · Supplier Relationship Management · Sourcing · Vendor Management

positions.title: Account Manager
positions.description:
I successfully managed customer interactions at Bank of America, focusing on delivering high-quality service and resolving issues effectively.  

• Processed orders and handled billing, ensuring accurate payment collection and account adjustments.  
• Maintained detailed records of customer interactions to facilitate prompt resolutions and enhance service delivery.  
• Promoted additional services, contributing to the growth of sales and customer satisfaction.
positions.insights: Skills: Complaint Management · Problem Solving · Management · Account Administration · Accounting Balances · Sales · Communication · Customer Satisfaction · Escalation Resolution

positions.title: Store Manager
positions.description: I led a diverse team, managing staffing challenges, conflict resolution, and disciplinary actions while ensuring a positive work environment. I oversaw recruitment, employee orientation, and scheduling to maintain an efficient workforce. I administered labor relations and training programs, ensuring staff adherence to company policies and driving employee retention through exit interviews. I also managed the store’s budget, optimized resource allocation, and coordinated sales promotions to improve performance. Additionally, I engaged in hands-on customer service, supported inventory management, and contributed to store layout planning to enhance product visibility and drive sales.
positions.insights: Skills: People Management · Sales Performance · Operational Planning · Inventory Management · Hiring · Staff Retention · Budgeting · Management · Training · Recruiting · Human Resources (HR) · Scheduling · Product Visualization
